data.name: Bob
data.message: Charlie, want to buddy up? I'm doing cameras then heading to navigation.

I found Alice's body in electrical. My route was weapons → security → electrical. I saw Charlie in security at tick 6 — he came in from navigation. When I entered electrical, Alice's body was already there. Whoever killed her was in electrical right before me, and they must have left through cafeteria or storage since I came from security. Charlie's the only player I saw, and he was heading the opposite direction. Need to hear where everyone else was.

I was on the left side early — oxygen to upper engine, saw Eve there around tick 2, then I went medbay. I saw Alice in medbay around tick 4 and then she went toward electrical. I briefly saw Bob leaving electrical toward security right as Alice was going in, then I headed up toward cafeteria. Alice was alive when I last saw her, so the timing is really tight.

Frank, if you came from security into electrical, did you see Bob at all? Because Bob leaving electrical right before Alice dies feels like the key thing to explain. Charlie being in security from navigation sounds less direct to me unless he doubled back somehow.

I can confirm part of Diana's story — she was with me in upper engine around ticks 1-2, coming in from oxygen. After that I went to oxygen myself and stayed working on tasks, so I didn't see anything in the electrical area.

So Diana has at least a partial alibi with me for the early ticks. The big question is Bob — Diana places him leaving electrical right as Alice was entering, which is suspicious timing. Frank, coming from security, would have seen Bob if Bob went that way — so did you? If Bob wasn't in security when you passed through, then he either doubled back into electrical or went somewhere else entirely.

I'd really like to hear Bob and Charlie account for themselves before I commit to a vote.

Okay, listen carefully because Diana's story doesn't match mine at all.

My route was medbay → electrical → security. I was in electrical around tick 5, and Diana was there with me — not in medbay like she's claiming. I did NOT see Alice in electrical when I was there. After that I moved to security, where I've been with Charlie at ticks 7 and 8.

So Diana is lying about her position. She says she saw me "leaving electrical toward security right as Alice was going in" — but she was IN electrical with me at tick 5. She's fabricating a sighting to frame me, and she's placing Alice in electrical at a time that conveniently sets up the kill.

Frank found Alice's body in electrical. Diana was in electrical with me. After I left for security, Diana would have been alone there — and she's the one inventing a story to pin it on me.

Eve gives Diana a partial alibi for ticks 1-2, but that's way before the kill. Charlie vouches for me in security from tick 7 onward, and Frank saw Charlie coming from navigation into security — consistent.

I'm voting Diana. Her story directly contradicts what I saw, and she had the opportunity.

Okay, here's what I can confirm from my side:

My route was navigation → security. I arrived in security at tick 6, and Frank passed through around then coming from weapons — consistent with his story. Then at tick 7, Bob entered security from electrical. He's been with me in security since. So Bob's claim that he was in security with me from tick 7 onward checks out, and I can confirm he came from electrical, matching his own route.

Now the key conflict: Diana says she saw Bob "leaving electrical toward security right as Alice was going in" — but she places herself going from medbay UP toward cafeteria after that. Meanwhile Bob says Diana was IN electrical with him at tick 5. 

Here's what's damning: Frank entered electrical from security after Bob left, and found Alice's body already there. Bob came straight to security from electrical and stayed with me. That means whoever was in electrical AFTER Bob left and BEFORE Frank arrived is the killer. Bob couldn't have doubled back — he's been in my sight.

Diana's story puts her near electrical with no witness for the critical window, and she's actively contradicting Bob's account of her being in electrical. She's trying to redirect onto Bob, but Bob has me as an alibi for the post-kill window.

I'm voting Diana.

Wait, I already spoke first — but I want to add to what I said now that I've heard the others.

To confirm Charlie's account: yes, I came from weapons into security at tick 6, and Charlie was there having just come from navigation. That all lines up. I then moved into electrical and found Alice's body.

The critical window is between Bob leaving electrical and me arriving. Bob says he went electrical → security and Charlie confirms Bob arrived in security at tick 7 and stayed. If that's true, Bob is cleared by Charlie for the post-kill window.

Diana's story has a real problem: she claims she saw Bob leaving electrical toward security as Alice was entering — but I was in security at tick 6 coming from weapons, and I did NOT see Bob pass through toward security ahead of me. Bob arriving in security at tick 7 from electrical matches Charlie, not Diana's timing.

I'm leaning Diana. Her placement of Bob doesn't match what Charlie and I saw in security.

Bob is twisting the timing. I never said I was never near electrical — I said I was coming from medbay and heading up toward cafeteria. I passed through the electrical side, saw Alice come in from medbay and Bob leaving toward security, and I kept moving. I did not stop there with Alice.

The part that bothers me is Bob saying he “didn’t see Alice” when I literally saw Alice enter electrical at the same time Bob was leaving. That’s a huge thing to miss if he was actually there innocently.

Also, Frank not seeing Bob at tick 6 doesn’t clear Bob — electrical to security takes time, so Bob leaving at tick 5 and showing up around tick 7 is exactly consistent with what I said. Charlie seeing him at tick 7 only clears him after that, not before.

Bob is acting like Charlie clears the whole kill window, but he only clears Bob once Bob reached security. Alice died in electrical right after Bob was there, and Bob is denying seeing the victim enter. That’s way more suspicious than me continuing to cafeteria.

Okay, I've already given my main observations, but let me weigh in now that I've heard everyone.

The key conflict is really between Bob and Diana. Charlie and Frank both confirm Bob arrived in security at tick 7 from electrical and stayed there. That's solid. Diana's claim that Bob left electrical "toward security" as Alice was entering is actually *consistent* with Bob arriving in security at tick 7 — travel time accounts for that gap.

But here's what gives me pause about Bob: he flatly denies seeing Alice in electrical at all, and he claims Diana was in electrical with him. Diana says she passed through. One of them is lying about that overlap.

If Bob was in electrical right before Alice died, and he says he didn't see her — either he's lying about not seeing her (because he killed her), or Diana is lying about Alice entering as he left.

Frank found the body, so Alice was definitely in electrical. Bob saying he didn't see her there is the part that smells off to me. Diana at least acknowledges seeing Alice alive heading in.

I'm leaning Bob, but I want to be honest — I don't have direct evidence either way past tick 2. Between the two, Bob denying seeing the victim in the room he admits being in is the bigger red flag for me.

I need to push back hard here because the narrative is getting twisted.

Let me restate the facts from MY perspective: I was in medbay at tick 3-4, moved to electrical at tick 5, then to security at tick 7. Diana was in electrical WITH ME at tick 5. Alice was NOT in electrical when I was there — if she had been, I would have seen her, and more importantly, Diana would be a direct witness to me NOT killing her.

Diana's now shifting her story. First she said she saw me "leaving electrical toward security right as Alice was going in" while she was heading from medbay up to cafeteria. Now she's saying she "passed through the electrical side." Which is it? She's adjusting her position to stay plausible.

Eve, I hear your concern, but think about it: if Diana was actually just passing through and saw Alice enter as I left, then Diana is the LAST person confirmed in electrical before Frank found the body. She has motive to lie about Alice's timing to frame me.

Also — Diana claimed she saw Alice in medbay at tick 4 heading to electrical. I was in medbay at tick 4. I did not see Diana there. That's another contradiction.

The killer is whoever was in electrical between me leaving and Frank arriving. Charlie confirms I went straight to security and stayed. Diana, by her own admission, was right there in the electrical area during that exact window with no witness.

I'm voting Diana.

I'll stick with what I can confirm and what the evidence shows.

Hard facts from my position: Bob arrived in security from electrical at tick 7 and has been with me since. Frank arrived in security at tick 6 from weapons. Both consistent with their stories.

The killer was in electrical between Bob leaving (tick 5-6) and Frank arriving (tick 7). Bob is cleared for that post-departure window because he was with me.

Now, Diana's story has shifted — first she was "heading up to cafeteria from medbay," now she "passed through the electrical side." Bob also points out she claimed to see Alice in medbay at tick 4, but Bob was in medbay at tick 4 and didn't see Diana. That's two contradictions.

Eve's point about Bob not seeing Alice is fair, but if Diana was passing through electrical right as Alice entered and Bob left, then Diana is the last confirmed person in electrical before the body was found — with no witness for that window.

Bob has me as a hard alibi post-kill. Diana has nobody for the critical window and her story keeps adjusting.

I'm voting Diana.
